changelog: Brand Identity Upgrade: Official REDDOT WORKSTATION designation across UI viewport.
Precision Work Hours Engine: Resolved false shift timing calculations, eliminating previous-day stale hours leakage and double-counting.
Real-Time Shift Audit Trail: Distinct per-session durations for Clock-Out / Break events and live elapsed tracking for active duties.
Drift-Free Wall-Clock Shift Timer: High-precision wall-clock time tracking, eliminating time loss from PC sleep or suspension.
Concurrency-Safe Persistence Engine: Atomic queued file-writing preventing Windows disk file locking collisions.
Automatic Shift & Member Hygiene: Workstation automatically sanitizes stale metrics and marks inactive members offline on launch.
